CREATE TABLE "public"."call" (
  "companionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "conversationId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endedAt" timestamptz,
  "errorCode" text,
  "errorMessage" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "metadata" json,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "providerCallId" text,
  "roomId" text,
  "startedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "call_status_check_f377cdca" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'CONNECTING', 'ACTIVE', 'ENDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "call_type_check_bb1ca145" CHECK ("type" IN ('AUDIO', 'VIDEO'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."deviceToken" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "platform" text NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."imageGeneration" (
  "companionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "conversationId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "enhancedPrompt" text,
  "errorCode" text,
  "errorMessage" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text,
  "messageId" int4,
  "metadata" json,
  "model" text,
  "prompt" text NOT NULL,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "providerImageId" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "imageGeneration_status_check_48358bb5" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED')),
  CONSTRAINT "imageGeneration_type_check_ba834aee" CHECK ("type" IN ('COMPANION_AVATAR', 'COMPANION_IMAGE', 'USER_REQUEST'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."subscription" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "plan" text DEFAULT 'FREE' NOT NULL,
  "provider" text,
  "providerSubscriptionId" text,
  "startedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "subscription_plan_check_0f874b4b" CHECK ("plan" IN ('FREE', 'PREMIUM', 'PREMIUM_PLUS')),
  CONSTRAINT "subscription_status_check_21af5e2c" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'TRIALING', 'PAST_DUE', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."usageRecord" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "feature" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "metadata" json,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "usageRecord_feature_check_94e56e34" CHECK ("feature" IN ('TEXT_TOKENS', 'MESSAGES', 'IMAGE_GENERATIONS', 'VOICE_MINUTES', 'AUDIO_CALL_MINUTES', 'VIDEO_CALL_MINUTES'))
)
